items.title: Inference Is Not Training: What AI Inference Demand Means for Colocation Design
items.summary: TL;DR AI inference is rapidly matching model training as a major driver of high-density colocation demand, running continuously in production rather than in concentrated runs. Unlike training workloads with synchronized power spikes, inference draw follows daily interactive user traffic and leaves roughly 21% power headroom, allowing operators to pack more servers into existing capacity. items.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports NCCL profiling for training jobs

SageMaker HyperPod helps you scale generative AI model development across hundreds or thousands of AI accelerators. Previously, one throttled GPU or degraded link could slow the whole job without an error, and finding it meant stopping the job to run NCCL tests.
